tagline.sw: Kwa wasanidi programu wanaotaka kujenga kwa Bitcoin, Lightning na Fedimint, na kuchangia Bitsacco.
tagline.en: For developers who want to build on Bitcoin, Lightning and Fedimint, and contribute to Bitsacco.

description.sw: Kutoka maabara yako ya regtest hadi miamala, funguo, Lightning na Fedimint, kisha jenga programu ndogo na uchangie programu huria. Unahitaji kujua kutumia terminal na lugha moja ya programu.
description.en: From your own regtest lab to transactions, keys, Lightning and Fedimint, then build a mini-app and contribute to open source. You should be comfortable with a terminal and one programming language.

outcomes.sw: Endesha mtandao binafsi wa majaribio wa Bitcoin kwenye kompyuta yako
outcomes.en: Run a private Bitcoin test network on your own computer

outcomes.sw: Elewa jinsi Lightning na Fedimint zinavyofanya kazi ndani
outcomes.en: Understand how Lightning and Fedimint work underneath

outcomes.sw: Changia miradi ya chanzo huria na utengeneze zana ndogo kwa ajili ya jamii yako
outcomes.en: Contribute to open-source projects and ship a small tool for your community

format.sw: Masomo manane ya vitendo kwa kutumia regtest, kwa hiyo hakuna pesa halisi. Kila somo linaishia na majadiliano na jaribio, na la mwisho ni mradi.
format.en: Eight hands-on lessons on regtest, so no real money is involved. Each lesson ends with discussion and a quiz, and the last one is a project.

audience.sw: Watu wanaoweza kutumia terminal wanaotaka kujenga zana kwa ajili ya vikundi vya akiba na jamii.
audience.en: People comfortable with a terminal who want to build tools for savings groups and communities.
